title: Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program (BPMSP) - TVET Track
provider: Technical Education and Skills Development Authority
description: TVET diploma track under the joint CHED-DepEd-TESDA Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program. Targets priority diploma programs with minimum 90% GWA and combined household income up to 2000000 PHP. Includes mandatory return-of-service of one year in the Philippines for every year of funding.
